opportunities.title: Culinary Plating Competition
opportunities.summary: Present a North Sumatran dish and tell the story behind its design.
opportunities.description: Teams prepare one main dish for the Nusantara Tourism Expo. At the event, each team has 20 minutes to arrange its plate and five minutes to present its cultural story.

eligibility.label: Each team member is a university or upper-secondary student.
Your team has two or three members.

guidelines: Register one main dish. Supply its name, region of origin, description, plating concept and cultural story.
The entry fee is IDR 50,000 per team. Bring ingredients and special plating equipment.
The organizer schedules on-site plating in Medan for 1 December 2026.

skills.title: Create a focal point
skills.indicator: The finished plate uses height or placement to direct attention to its main component.

skills.title: Explain a dish’s cultural context
skills.indicator: A presentation connects the dish with its regional identity and explains one meaningful ingredient or technique.

opportunities.title: EF Hult Prize 2027
opportunities.summary: Pitch a student-led startup that addresses a UN Sustainable Development Goal.
opportunities.description: A team develops a for-profit venture and submits an English pitch video and deck. The qualifier submission deadline below applies to that stage. Local competition schedules can differ.

eligibility.label: Your team has two to four members.
All members are enrolled in a degree or equivalent program of at least two academic years and reach age 18 by 28 February 2027.
The team represents one university and proposes a for-profit venture that addresses a UN Sustainable Development Goal.
The team meets the organizer’s ownership, leadership, local entry route and conflict-of-interest rules.

guidelines: Choose the local route if one is available, unless the organizer grants a written exception.
Prepare a four-minute pitch video in English and a PDF pitch deck. The team captain receives the submission link after registration.
Confirm ownership and representation with the organizer. A local event can have an earlier deadline.

skills.title: Present a problem and solution
skills.indicator: The pitch identifies a specific beneficiary, describes the problem and explains how the venture would address it.

skills.title: Support a market claim
skills.indicator: A market slide identifies an external source and its publication year.

resource.title: Use references in a pitch deck

opportunities.title: RPS Student Food Photographer of the Year
opportunities.summary: Enter up to five food photographs in the awards’ student category.
opportunities.description: This category is free for eligible photography students. The organizer accepts entries from around the world. A general culinary or hospitality enrollment alone does not establish the photography-course requirement.

eligibility.label: You attend a photography course at a recognized college or university, or finished one within the previous 12 months.
Your entry meets the age, authorship, permissions and exclusion rules in the organizer’s terms.

guidelines: Submit up to five entries in this category. Check the file specifications and image rights in the terms.
The organizer describes closing as midnight GMT on 7 February. Submit before the closing day if timing matters.

skills.title: Control light in a food photograph
skills.indicator: A photograph uses the direction of light to show the surface texture of its subject.

opportunities.title: China–Indonesia Higher Education Scholarship
opportunities.organization: Embassy of the People's Republic of China in Indonesia
opportunities.summary: Apply for an undergraduate scholarship in a supported field, including tourism.
opportunities.description: This listing covers the undergraduate route for 2027/28. The bilateral program includes tourism among its named subjects. It covers study costs under the scholarship terms. International travel is excluded.

eligibility.label: You are a high-school graduate under 25 and meet the undergraduate entry requirements.
You have a valid CSCA result and a pre-admission document from a target university.
You meet the organizer’s citizenship, health, university admission and language requirements.

guidelines: Apply before 14 February 2027. The embassy gives no cutoff hour or time zone in its notice.
Submit through Campus China with Indonesian agency number 3602.
Prepare the statement in Chinese or English. The published undergraduate minimum is 200 words. Check all documents with the target university.

skills.title: Write a study plan
skills.indicator: The study plan is written in Chinese or English and meets the undergraduate minimum of 200 words.

resource.title: Read the undergraduate study-plan requirements
resource.provider: Embassy of the People's Republic of China in Indonesia
